action: No action needed; service is restored. Businesses that depend on Docomo 5G for critical connections may wish to confirm their backup connection works.
exec: A same-day 5G network failure at a major Japanese carrier, attributed to equipment congestion rather than a security event.
plain: NTT Docomo's newest 5G mobile network in Japan failed on November 16 and was restored the same day. The company says overloaded network equipment caused it; no cyberattack is indicated.
summary: Docomo's standalone 5G network failed on November 16 and was restored the same day. The stated cause is switch congestion. Details come from one outage roundup; no cyber cause is indicated.
title: NTT Docomo 5G network outage in Japan
